description: This file implements a validator class for the Visit entity in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It defines validation rules for visit data, including date consistency, overlaps, patient information, and attributes. The validator ensures that visits conform to business rules before saving.

classes.name: VisitValidator
classes.description: A validator class for the Visit entity, implementing validation logic to ensure visits are correctly defined before persistence.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the given class can be validated by this validator; supports the Visit class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs extensive validation on a Visit object, checking date consistency, overlaps, attributes, and other business rules.

methods.name: disallowOverlappingVisits
methods.description: Determines if overlapping visits are disallowed based on global configuration.

methods.name: allowOverlappingVisits
methods.description: Checks global configuration to see if overlapping visits are permitted.

methods.name: validateVisitStartedBeforePatientBirthdate
methods.description: Ensures the visit start date is not before the patient's birthdate.

methods.name: getPatientBirthdateAdjustedIfEstimated
methods.description: Adjusts patient's birthdate for estimation if marked as estimated, considering the age.

methods.name: calculateGracePeriodInYears
methods.description: Calculates a grace period in years for estimated birthdates based on patient's age.
